chk_scale.note: no calipers (scan-only, DECISIONS.md MEASUREMENTS): units assumed mm, scale unverified

primary.why: three moulded bayonet lug pads, coplanar and square to the cup axis; they carry the portafilter bayonet (function) and are the cleanest flat that is square to the axis (the floor plate is tilted/warped ~0.3 deg vs the axis, see INTAKE_CARD)

xy.why: cup outer cylinder = portafilter/bayonet rotation axis; cleanest cylinder (round within +-0.09 over the ~270 deg the scan covers)

origin.definition: cup outer-wall axis ∩ bayonet lug top plane

clock.why: 3 bayonet lugs are the only non-axisymmetric features the scan resolves
clock.label_rule: lug 1 = the 3-fold candidate nearest +X after levelling (convention; lugs are nominally identical, see card)

landmarks.name: rim top above lug plane
landmarks.tol_source: pre-alignment r-z survey (pre_rz.png): rim 31.2 vs lug top 27.84, +-0.4 for the provisional frame
